main.description: Add an account to the requester's list of system accounts. proof is a service token minted by that account's own server (com.atproto.server.getServiceAuth) with aud this AppView and lxm app.nearhorizon.account.confirmSystemAccount, a name no route serves. The requester's token and the proof each live at most 65 seconds (exp minus iat) and are accepted once: a token used by a request that succeeded is refused, a token used only by a refused request is not. Idempotent: an account already on the list keeps its addedAt, and the answer is the list's current rev. Requires auth; any signed-in account.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The input is malformed, account is not a DID, or account is the requester.

errors.name: InvalidProof
errors.description: The proof did not verify, lives over 65 seconds, was issued by another account, or was already used.

errors.name: InvalidToken
errors.description: The requester's token lives over 65 seconds or was already used (HTTP 401).

errors.name: MethodNotImplemented
errors.description: System accounts are not served by this AppView (HTTP 501).
